choose.when: SELECT id,model_code code,model_name name,NULL contact_name,NULL contact_phone,CASE enabled WHEN 1 THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END status,updated_at FROM bike_product_model WHERE model_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id,customer_code code,customer_name name,contact_name,contact_phone,status,updated_at FROM bike_customer WHERE customer_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id,supplier_code code,supplier_name name,contact_name,contact_phone,status,updated_at FROM bike_supplier WHERE supplier_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id,agent_code code,agent_name name,contact_name,contact_phone,status,updated_at FROM bike_agent WHERE agent_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id,warehouse_code code,warehouse_name name,NULL contact_name,NULL contact_phone,status,updated_at FROM bike_warehouse WHERE warehouse_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR warehouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id,m.model_code code,m.model_name name,NULL contact_name,NULL contact_phone,CASE m.enabled WHEN 1 THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END status,m.updated_at FROM bike_product_model m JOIN bike_inventory_lock l ON l.product_model_id=m.id WHERE l.agent_id=#{agentId} AND l.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND l.expire_time>NOW() AND m.enabled=1 AND (m.model_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR m.model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC
